# Nonna Box

> > Nonna Box delivers authentic Italian recipes and culinary traditions from regions like Emilia-Romagna, Sicily, Tuscany, and Liguria, featuring traditional dishes, cooking techniques, and ingredient guides.

Nonna Box celebrates Italian cuisine through regional recipes, cooking guides, and cultural insights. The site features traditional dishes from Italy's diverse culinary regions, from Sicilian street food to Tuscan classics, with a focus on authentic techniques and ingredients like Arborio rice, porcini mushrooms, and San Marzano tomatoes.

## Key Topics

- Italian cuisine
- Risotto recipes
- Vegetarian recipes
- Traditional Italian recipes
- Sicilian cuisine
- Emilia-Romagna
- Tuscany
- Arborio rice
- Porcini mushrooms
- Italian street food
- Regional Italian cooking
- Italian appetizers
- Pasta dishes
- Italian desserts

## Pasta & Risotto Recipes

- [Risotto With Red Wine Is Just As Delicious As It Sounds](https://www.nonnabox.com/risotto-with-red-wine): Red wine risotto recipe from Emilia-Romagna region
- [Easy Risotto with Dried Mushrooms Recipe - Outstanding!](https://www.nonnabox.com/risotto-with-dried-mushrooms): Vegetarian porcini mushroom risotto recipe from Italy
- [Easy Herby Lemon Risotto with Halloumi Recipe - Authentic Italian Recipes](https://www.nonnabox.com/herby-lemon-risotto-halloumi): Vegetarian lemon risotto with halloumi cheese
- [Risotto with Milk Recipe - A Simple and Delicious Recipe](https://www.nonnabox.com/risotto-with-milk): Simple milk-based risotto with Arborio rice
- [Authentic Penne all'Arrabbiata Recipe | Angry Sauce Pasta](https://www.nonnabox.com/penne-allarrabbiata-recipe): Roman spicy arrabbiata pasta with tomato sauce
- [Baked Anelletti Recipe - Timballo di Anelletti al Forno](https://www.nonnabox.com/baked-anelletti): Sicilian baked pasta timballo from Trapani
- [Spaghetti Pasta with Mussels and Tomato Garlic Sauce](https://www.nonnabox.com/spaghetti-pasta-with-mussels): Sicilian seafood pasta with mussels and San Marzano tomatoes
- [Eggplant Lasagna Recipe with Ricotta and Herbs](https://www.nonnabox.com/eggplant-lasagna): Vegetarian eggplant lasagna with ricotta and herbs
